question: Which of the following is odourless, tasteless and non-toxic, and is made up of 93.05% methane, nitrogen, carbon dioxide, propane and traces of ethane?
solution:
The correct answer is **__CNG.__****__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Its primary use is as an alternative for fuel in automobiles.
 
• The primary component in CNG is methane.
 
• Natural gas is an odourless,** ****tasteless and non-toxic ****g**aseous mixture of hydrocarbons—predominantly made up of methane (CH4).
 
• CNG is produced by compressing natural gas to less than 1% of its volume at standard atmospheric pressure. 
 
• The primary source of obtaining CNG is from oil wells, bed methane wells, coal wells and even natural gas wells.
 
• CNG is used in the light, medium and heavy-duty applications.
 
• A CNG-powered vehicle gets about the same fuel economy as a conventional gasoline vehicle
 
• CNG is known to be an eco-friendly alternative option to gasoline which is harmful to nature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 LPG
 
 
 
• On liquefaction, petroleum gas changes into a liquid which is called liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG).
 
• The main constituent of LPG is butane though it contains smaller amounts of ethane and propane also.
 
 
 
 

 Chlorine
 
 
 
• The position of Chlorine is Group VII & 3rd series according to Mendeleev's periodic table.
 
• The atomic number of Chlorine is 17 and comes under the group called Halogens.
 
• Chlorine has the highest electron affinity.
 
• The atomic mass of Chlorine is 35.5. 
 
 
 
 

 Gobar gas
 
 
 
• Biogas is also known as Gobar Gas.
 
• It is produced through the anaerobic decomposition of organic wastes from animals and plants.
 
• It is primarily a mixture of mainly **methane and carbon dioxide** and methane is a major component of biogas.
